name: Rough Quartz
summary: In Durotar, a Rough Quartz comes from a Minor Manifestation of Earth. A shaman brings the stone to an elder, who binds it into the first Earth Totem.

sections.title: Heart of the Earth Totem
sections.body: Rough Quartz is a gift from a Minor Manifestation of Earth to a shaman who communes with the spirits in Durotar or Mulgore. To the untrained eye, it looks like an ordinary desert pebble. The stone represents endurance, patience, and unwavering strength. At the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller binds it into carved wood to make an Earth Totem. The quartz becomes the spiritual focus joining a young shaman to Azeroth's living soil.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Rough Quartz?
aliases: why do i need rough quartz
faq.answer: An elder shaman binds Rough Quartz into the initiate's first Earth Totem as its spiritual core. The stone also shows that the novice has communed with the elemental earth spirit.

faq.q: Who gives you the Rough Quartz?
aliases: where do i get rough quartz
faq.answer: A Minor Manifestation of Earth grants you Rough Quartz after you commune with the spirit during the Call of Earth ritual in Durotar or Mulgore.

faq.q: Who do I bring this stone to in Durotar?
aliases: where to turn in rough quartz
faq.answer: Bring Rough Quartz to Canaga Earthcaller, the shaman trainer in the Valley of Trials. Canaga fashions it into your Earth Totem.

faq.q: Is this quartz used for anything else?
aliases: is rough quartz used in crafting
faq.answer: No. Rough Quartz is solely a sacred ritual object for crafting an Earth Totem and has no use in common trade.

angles.text: As a shaman, Rough Quartz marks your first communion with the element of earth. It anchors your spells and marks your path as a conduit of the spirits.
